source_note: Museum Workflow: The AHG's own set of museum collection workflows, written for Heratio (November 2026). Licensed with Heratio under AGPL-3.0-or-later. Institutions adapt the steps to their own policies.

object_entry.name: Museum Workflow: Incoming objects
object_entry.label: Incoming objects
object_entry.description: Log anything that arrives at the museum, whatever the reason, so someone is accountable for it from the first day.

steps.name: Log the arrival
steps.instructions: Note who brought the object, when, how it was packed and why it is here (offer, loan, enquiry, return).

steps.name: Give the depositor a receipt
steps.instructions: Hand over a signed receipt listing each item and the terms it is held on, and keep a copy on the record.

steps.name: Look it over
steps.instructions: Check the object and its packaging for damage, pests or hazards, and photograph anything worth noting.

steps.name: Put it somewhere safe
steps.instructions: Place it in the holding area, record that location, and label it with its temporary number.

steps.name: Pass it on
steps.instructions: Route the object to the next workflow (acquisition, incoming loan, return to owner) and close this record.

acquisition.name: Museum Workflow: Acquiring an object
acquisition.label: Acquiring an object
acquisition.description: Bring an object into the permanent collection: decide, take ownership, number it and record it for good.

steps.name: Make the case
steps.instructions: Write up what the object is, where it came from, its condition, cost and why it fits the collecting policy.

steps.name: Check provenance and title
steps.instructions: Confirm the seller or donor has the right to transfer it, and check export, import and cultural-property rules.

steps.name: Get the decision
steps.instructions: The acquisitions committee or delegated officer accepts or declines; record the decision and any conditions.

steps.name: Take ownership
steps.instructions: Have the transfer of title signed and file it with the record.

steps.name: Number and record
steps.instructions: Give the object its permanent number, mark or tag it, and complete the accession record.

inventory.name: Museum Workflow: Stocktake
inventory.label: Stocktake
inventory.description: Confirm that what the records say the museum holds is really there, and where the records say it is.

steps.name: Choose what to check
steps.instructions: Pick the scope - one store, a sample, or everything - and set dates and people.

steps.name: Check each item
steps.instructions: Find each object, compare it with its record and location, and mark it found, missing or misplaced.

steps.name: Chase the gaps
steps.instructions: Look into every mismatch: recent moves, open loans, exits, or objects found without a record.

steps.name: Report
steps.instructions: Summarise what was checked, what is still unresolved and what will be done about it.

location_movement.name: Museum Workflow: Moving objects
location_movement.label: Moving objects
location_movement.description: Know where every object is and keep a trail of every move.

steps.name: Say why it is moving
steps.instructions: Record the reason: display, storage change, loan, photography, treatment.

steps.name: Plan the move
steps.instructions: Agree route, packing, handlers and timing, and note any risks to the object.

steps.name: Move it
steps.instructions: Mark the object as in transit, move it as planned, and note anything that went wrong.

steps.name: Confirm where it is now
steps.instructions: Record the new location and close the move.

cataloguing.name: Museum Workflow: Describing an object
cataloguing.label: Describing an object
cataloguing.description: Build the main record that says what an object is, who made it, and what it means.

steps.name: Identify it
steps.instructions: Name the object type, materials, technique and maker, using the museum's vocabularies.

steps.name: Describe it
steps.instructions: Add measurements, inscriptions and marks, dates, place of making and the object's history.

steps.name: Index it
steps.instructions: Add subjects, people and places as access points so the object can be found.

steps.name: Check it
steps.instructions: A second person checks the record for accuracy and consistency.

steps.name: Publish it
steps.instructions: Make the record visible to staff and, where suitable, to the public.

object_exit.name: Museum Workflow: Outgoing objects
object_exit.label: Outgoing objects
object_exit.description: Record anything leaving the museum's care, for a while or for good.

steps.name: Say why it is leaving
steps.instructions: Record the reason: loan out, return of a loan, transfer, treatment elsewhere, disposal.

steps.name: Get sign-off
steps.instructions: Get approval from the person who can authorise this kind of exit.

steps.name: Record its state
steps.instructions: Photograph the object and complete a condition report before it goes.

steps.name: Hand it over
steps.instructions: Hand over against a signed receipt, recording the date and who collected it.

steps.name: Close the record
steps.instructions: Update the object's status and location and close this record.

loans_in.name: Museum Workflow: Borrowing objects
loans_in.label: Borrowing objects
loans_in.description: Manage objects borrowed from other owners, from first request to safe return.

steps.name: Ask
steps.instructions: Send the lender the request: what, why, for how long, and the display and security conditions on offer.

steps.name: Agree terms
steps.instructions: Sign the loan agreement; both sides keep a copy.

steps.name: Cover and transport
steps.instructions: Arrange insurance or indemnity, packing, transport and any courier.

steps.name: Receive and check
steps.instructions: Check the object against the lender's condition report on arrival and note any differences.

steps.name: Return
steps.instructions: Send the object back, get a signed receipt from the lender and close the loan.

loans_out.name: Museum Workflow: Lending objects
loans_out.label: Lending objects
loans_out.description: Manage objects the museum lends to others.

steps.name: Assess the request
steps.instructions: Check the borrower's purpose, venue, security and environment against the museum's lending terms.

steps.name: Agree terms
steps.instructions: Issue the agreement covering duration, conditions, insurance and credit line.

steps.name: Record its state
steps.instructions: Photograph and report the object's condition before it leaves and share it with the borrower.

steps.name: Send it
steps.instructions: Pack and ship it, with a courier if needed, and confirm the borrower received it.

steps.name: Check it back in
steps.instructions: On return, compare its condition with the outgoing report and record any change.

insurance.name: Museum Workflow: Insurance cover
insurance.label: Insurance cover
insurance.description: Keep insurance and indemnity in line with what the museum holds and lends.

steps.name: Set values
steps.instructions: Agree insured values for the collection and for each loan.

steps.name: Check the policy
steps.instructions: Compare cover with current risks and renew or change it with the insurer.

steps.name: Keep the schedules
steps.instructions: Maintain the list of insured items, exclusions and anything the insurer must be told.

steps.name: Yearly review
steps.instructions: Review cover, values and claims once a year.

damage_loss.name: Museum Workflow: Damage or loss
damage_loss.label: Damage or loss
damage_loss.description: Respond quickly when an object is damaged or missing, and keep a full record of what happened.

steps.name: Make it safe
steps.instructions: Protect the object and the area, stop further harm, and tell the registrar.

steps.name: Assess
steps.instructions: A conservator records the damage and its likely cause, or the circumstances of the loss.

steps.name: Report
steps.instructions: Write up what happened, what was done straight away and what should change.

steps.name: Plan the fix
steps.instructions: Plan treatment or recovery, or start the search and any insurance claim.

steps.name: Close
steps.instructions: Record the outcome - repaired, written off, or still under investigation - and update the object's record.

conservation.name: Museum Workflow: Care and treatment
conservation.label: Care and treatment
conservation.description: Look after objects' physical condition, through good storage and display and, when needed, treatment.

steps.name: Assess
steps.instructions: Examine the object and record its condition.

steps.name: Propose treatment
steps.instructions: The conservator sets out aims, methods, materials, risks and alternatives.

steps.name: Approve
steps.instructions: The responsible curator or manager approves the proposal.

steps.name: Treat and record
steps.instructions: Carry out the work and record materials, methods and before-and-after images.

steps.name: Prevent it happening again
steps.instructions: Review storage or display conditions and update the care plan.

audit.name: Museum Workflow: Records audit
audit.label: Records audit
audit.description: Check, on a sample, that records and procedures are being kept properly.

steps.name: Plan
steps.instructions: Set the scope, sample and timetable, and name the auditor.

steps.name: Check
steps.instructions: Test the sample against objects, locations and the steps that should have been followed.

steps.name: Write up
steps.instructions: Record what was checked, what was right, and what was wrong or missing.

steps.name: Respond
steps.instructions: Managers agree corrective actions and owners.

steps.name: Report
steps.instructions: Share the final report with the governing body and track the actions.

condition_check.name: Museum Workflow: Condition check
condition_check.label: Condition check
condition_check.description: Record an object's physical state - routinely, and before and after loans, display or treatment.

steps.name: Look
steps.instructions: Examine structure, surface and materials and note what you see.

steps.name: Look closer
steps.instructions: Where needed, use magnification, raking or UV light and photography.

steps.name: Test
steps.instructions: Only where justified and affordable: scientific analysis such as X-ray or materials analysis.

steps.name: Report
steps.instructions: Complete the condition report with images and recommendations.

valuation.name: Museum Workflow: Valuing an object
valuation.label: Valuing an object
valuation.description: Set and keep up the values used for insurance, loans and reporting.

steps.name: Say why
steps.instructions: Record what the value is needed for: insurance, loan, disposal, or a routine review.

steps.name: Research
steps.instructions: Find prices for comparable objects and note the sources.

steps.name: Get an expert view
steps.instructions: Where needed, appoint an independent valuer and record their credentials.

steps.name: Record
steps.instructions: Record the value, its basis, the valuer and the date, and set the next review.

risk_management.name: Museum Workflow: Collection risks
risk_management.label: Collection risks
risk_management.description: Find the risks to the collection, rank them and reduce them.

steps.name: List risks
steps.instructions: Note risks in storage, display, transport, environment, security and governance.

steps.name: Rank them
steps.instructions: Score each one for likelihood and impact and set priorities.

steps.name: Plan actions
steps.instructions: Decide how each risk will be reduced, by whom and by when.

steps.name: Act
steps.instructions: Carry out the actions and keep evidence.

steps.name: Review
steps.instructions: Revisit the risk list regularly: rescore, add new risks, close those dealt with.

emergency_planning.name: Museum Workflow: Emergency readiness
emergency_planning.label: Emergency readiness
emergency_planning.description: Be ready to protect the collection in a fire, flood, theft or other emergency.

steps.name: Know the hazards
steps.instructions: List the hazards that apply to the building and collection.

steps.name: Write the plan
steps.instructions: Set salvage priorities, evacuation order, contacts and the emergency kit.

steps.name: Train people
steps.instructions: Make sure staff know the plan, their role and the equipment.

steps.name: Practise
steps.instructions: Run drills and record what was learnt.

steps.name: Update
steps.instructions: Revise the plan after drills, staff changes or new risks.

use_of_collections.name: Museum Workflow: Access and use
use_of_collections.label: Access and use
use_of_collections.description: Manage who uses collection objects for research, teaching or display, and on what terms.

steps.name: Request
steps.instructions: Record who wants to use what, why, when, and whether handling or photography is involved.

steps.name: Check
steps.instructions: Confirm identity and purpose and any ethical or rights issues.

steps.name: Decide
steps.instructions: Approve or decline, setting conditions such as supervision or no photography.

steps.name: Supervise
steps.instructions: Provide access on those terms and record what was used.

steps.name: Check afterwards
steps.instructions: Check the object's condition after use and close the request.

rights_management.name: Museum Workflow: Rights
rights_management.label: Rights
rights_management.description: Know and manage the rights attached to objects - copyright, moral rights, community and contractual restrictions.

steps.name: Identify
steps.instructions: Work out which rights apply and who holds them.

steps.name: Record
steps.instructions: Record holders, terms, expiry dates and the supporting documents.

steps.name: Ask permission
steps.instructions: Where the museum needs permission (for example to publish an image), request it and record the answer.

steps.name: Track licences
steps.instructions: Keep the list of licences and their conditions current.

steps.name: Review
steps.instructions: Review regularly for expiring rights, new claims and policy changes.

reproduction.name: Museum Workflow: Copies and images
reproduction.label: Copies and images
reproduction.description: Manage photographs, scans, replicas and other copies of objects.

steps.name: Request
steps.instructions: Record what is wanted, in what format and for what use.

steps.name: Clear rights
steps.instructions: Confirm the museum may make and supply the copy, or get permission.

steps.name: Make it
steps.instructions: Photograph, scan or produce the copy and record how it was made.

steps.name: Check quality
steps.instructions: Check colour, resolution, file naming and metadata.

steps.name: Deliver and file
steps.instructions: Supply the copy and keep the master in the digital asset store.

deaccessioning.name: Museum Workflow: Removing from the collection
deaccessioning.label: Removing from the collection
deaccessioning.description: Take an object out of the permanent collection properly, with approval and a permanent record.

steps.name: Make the case
steps.instructions: Set out why, the checks done, the ethical questions and the proposed method of disposal.

steps.name: Committee review
steps.instructions: The collections committee considers the case and recommends.

steps.name: Final approval
steps.instructions: The governing body decides; record the decision and any conditions.

steps.name: Carry it out
steps.instructions: Transfer, return, sell or, as a last resort, destroy, as approved.

steps.name: Keep the record
steps.instructions: Keep the full record permanently, even though the object has gone.

retrospective_doc.name: Museum Workflow: Documentation backlog
retrospective_doc.label: Documentation backlog
retrospective_doc.description: Bring older objects with missing or thin records up to the current standard.

steps.name: Find the gaps
steps.instructions: Survey the records and list objects that need work.

steps.name: Prioritise
steps.instructions: Rank by significance, risk and the time available.

steps.name: Record
steps.instructions: Catalogue each object to the current standard, reusing reliable old data.

steps.name: Verify
steps.instructions: Check identification and history against other sources where possible.

steps.name: Close the batch
steps.instructions: Bring the new records into the main catalogue and close the batch.
